info.name: Deligo Mapper API
info.description:
Delivery mapping and tracking service.

**Auth:** Protected endpoints require `x-api-key` header. Set the `api_key` collection variable.

**Folders:**
- System — health & root
- Delivery — internal CRUD (delivery.py router)
- Tracking — public customer view (delivery.py router)
- Driver — GPS reporting + driver's order list
- Shop — shop's order list + summary
- Location — geocoding utilities (no auth)

item.name: System
item.description: Health and welcome endpoints. No auth required.

request.description: Returns {"status": "ok"} when the service is up.

item.name: Delivery (Internal)
item.description:
Internal CRUD for delivery orders. All endpoints require X-API-Key.
Router: src/api/endpoints/delivery.py — prefix /api/delivery

request.description:
Create a new delivery order. Geocodes the customer address immediately.

Required: `sales_number`, `store_id`, `customer_address`.
Optional: `sales_id`, `is_countryside` (default false).

Driver assignment is no longer part of this payload — it comes from the order service.

Saves `sales_number` to the collection variable on success. Returns 201.

Fetch a single delivery order by sales number. Enriched with sales detail (including driver info) from the deligo integration service.

`detail` is populated by calling `POST /api/sales/get` on deligo with `{ id: <sales_id> }`. If the local row has no `sales_id`, `detail` will be `null` — make sure `sales_id` is supplied at create time.

body.raw:
{
  "latitude": 47.9184,
  "longitude": 106.9177,
  "formatted_address": "Сүхбаатар дүүрэг, 1-р хороо",
  "street_address": null,
  "district": "Сүхбаатар",
  "khoroo": "1-р хороо",
  "city": "Улаанбаатар",
  "state": null,
  "country": "Mongolia",
  "postal_code": null,
  "building": null
}

request.description:
Update with pre-geocoded coordinates. Returns 404 if order is not found or is already completed.

`building` can be an object: `{ building, entrance, floor, door, extra_notes }`.
Re-geocodes the new address string and stores the result. Returns 422 if geocoding fails.

Driver starts the delivery. Proxies to `POST https://api.deligo.mn/api/sales/changestatus` with `{ id: <sales_id>, statusId: 8 }` (salesDriverDone / Жолооч хүлээн авсан).

`sales_id` is resolved from the local delivery row (falling back to the deligo sales detail). No request body.

Errors: 404 if the delivery is unknown, 422 if no sales_id can be resolved, 502 if the deligo API rejects the call.

Only the start-delivery transition is supported for now.

Locks the delivery — map_status → completed. No further location edits are allowed after this.

(Renamed from `/complete` to `/map_edit` to reflect the map-editing workflow.)

item.name: Tracking (Customer / Public)
item.description:
Public endpoints for customers to track their own delivery. No API key required.
Router: src/api/endpoints/delivery.py — prefix /api/delivery

request.description: Customer-facing tracking. Returns current location, map_status, merged order detail, and `active_deliveries_count` (other in-progress deliveries for the same driver, excluding this one). No auth required.

item.name: Driver
item.description:
Driver-facing endpoints: report GPS position and view assigned orders.
GPS report/read require X-API-Key (driver.py router). A public location-read variant exists for customer maps.
Order list does not require auth (delivery.py router).

request.description: Driver pings their current GPS coordinates. Creates or updates the driver_location record.
Returns the driver's last known latitude/longitude and updated_at timestamp. Requires X-API-Key.
Same payload as the authenticated location endpoint, but exposed publicly for customer tracking maps. No auth required.
Returns deliveries assigned to this driver, sourced from the deligo integration service and joined with local delivery rows. No auth required.

item.name: Shop
item.description:
Shop-facing endpoints: view orders assigned to a store and a status-count summary. No auth required.
Router: src/api/endpoints/delivery.py — prefix /api/delivery

request.description: Returns delivery orders for this store, with merged order detail. No auth required.

Aggregate status counts for a shop's deliveries. Status is derived from the order service detail:

- `completed` — `is_closed` is truthy
- `in_progress` — `is_start_driver` is truthy
- `pending` — everything else
- `cancelled` — reserved (always 0 today)

Response: `{ status, data: { pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled, total } }`.

item.name: Location (Utilities)
item.description:
Geocoding and reverse-geocoding helpers. No API key required.
Router: src/api/endpoints/location.py — prefix /api/location

request.description: Converts coordinates to a structured Location object (address, district, khoroo, etc.).
Converts an address string to coordinates + structured Location. Returns 404 if geocoding finds no results.

body.raw:
{
  "formattedAddress": "Сүхбаатар дүүрэг, Улаанбаатар, Монгол",
  "streetAddress": "Peace Avenue 17",
  "district": "Сүхбаатар",
  "khoroo": "1-р хороо",
  "city": "Улаанбаатар",
  "state": null,
  "country": "Mongolia",
  "postalCode": "14200",
  "building": null,
  "coordinates": { "lat": 47.9184, "lng": 106.9177 }
}

request.description:
Accepts a Google Maps frontend location object and normalises it into the standard Location model.

All fields are optional. Accepted keys: `formattedAddress`, `streetAddress`, `city`, `state`, `district`, `khoroo`, `country`, `postalCode`, `building`, `coordinates: { lat, lng }`.
